// CASE js_inorder_regex_literal_apostrophe expect=pass
export async function inOrder(items, step, { reason }) {
  void reason;
  for (const item of items) {
    log(await step(item), /it's/);
  }
}
// CASE js_chunk_regex_literal_quote expect=pass
export async function mapLimit(items, width, operation) {
  for (let offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    sink.push((await Promise.all(items.slice(offset, offset + width).map(operation))).join(",").replace(/"/g, ""));
  }
}
// CASE js_chunk_regex_literal_control expect=pass
export async function mapLimit(items, width, operation) {
  for (let offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    sink.push((await Promise.all(items.slice(offset, offset + width).map(operation))).join(",").replace(/x/g, ""));
  }
}
// CASE js_chunk_regex_literal_block_open expect=pass
export async function mapLimit(items, width, operation) {
  for (let offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    sink.push((await Promise.all(items.slice(offset, offset + width).map(operation))).join(",").replace(/\/*$/, ""));
  }
}
